name: Sudharsan A
bio: I’m a senior software engineer in Chennai with 5+ years of frontend and full-stack work. At Arbaan GT I build Freshworks apps and the integrations around them. Before that, I led a headless e-commerce build at Thilash Services.
On Instagram I run @developer_coding_tricks: one tested trick a day that replaces a block of code with the line JavaScript, React or CSS already gives you. Every snippet is run before it’s posted.

I also take freelance projects: websites and React apps with SEO done properly, AI automations with Claude Code, Cowork and scheduled tasks, Freshdesk and Freshservice apps, and integrations that keep your CRM, helpdesk and internal tools in sync.

services.title: Websites and web apps
services.body: Business websites, landing pages, dashboards and full-stack apps that load fast and rank well from day one.

services.title: AI automations
services.body: Put Claude to work on the repetitive parts of your business: scheduled reports, inbox and ticket triage, and content drafts.
includes: Claude Code and Claude Cowork workflows

services.title: Freshworks apps
services.body: Custom and marketplace apps for Freshdesk and Freshservice, built with the Freshworks Developer Kit.

services.title: CRM, API and data integrations
services.body: Connect your CRM, helpdesk and business systems so data moves on its own, including large one-time migrations.

points: Build custom and marketplace apps on the Freshworks platform with React, Node.js and the Freshworks Developer Kit.
Integrate Freshdesk and Freshservice with external business systems using REST APIs and serverless architecture.
Led an enterprise migration that synced and validated 80,000+ employee, project and asset records into Freshservice.
Built Leads, Deals, Contacts and Invoices modules on Strapi CMS, and added OpenAI-powered content automation.
Do code reviews, debugging, performance work and production support.
Led the 12-month build of a headless e-commerce platform with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS and REST APIs, cutting client-side load times.
Redesigned the interfaces in Figma and improved Core Web Vitals and technical SEO.
Built an internal Customer Information Dashboard with React Hooks and React Table for filtering large client datasets.
Named Best Associate of the Month (August 2021) for debugging and issue resolution.

projects.title: developer_coding_tricks website
projects.body: This site: a fast, fully static Next.js site that turns each Instagram tip into a searchable, copyable page. Built with Claude Code, with SEO and security headers set up from the start.

projects.title: Custom Freshservice support portal
projects.body: A branded self-service portal on top of Freshservice. People sign in with company SSO, raise incidents and service requests, track and filter their tickets, read announcements, and escalate tickets that need attention. Available in English, French and Dutch.
projects.result: Runs on Kubernetes across dev, QA and production

projects.title: Enterprise data migration to Freshservice
